+"""Directed soft-code displacement hinge for source/target transitions."""

+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Return the masked directed repulsion loss (differentiable to all inputs)."""
+    tau = float(parameters.get("tau", 0.5))
+    margin = float(parameters.get("margin", 0.05))
+    epsilon = float(parameters.get("epsilon", 1e-8))
+    weight = float(parameters.get("lambda", 1e-4))
+    if tau <= 0 or epsilon <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau and epsilon must be positive")
+
+    source_logits = -torch.cdist(source, codebook).square() / tau
+    target_logits = -torch.cdist(target, codebook).square() / tau
+    source_assignment = F.softmax(source_logits, dim=-1)
+    target_assignment = F.softmax(target_logits, dim=-1)
+    displacement = source_assignment @ codebook - target_assignment @ codebook
+    direction = target - source
+    direction = direction / (direction.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + epsilon)
+    projected = (direction * displacement).sum(dim=-1)
+    per_row = F.relu(margin - projected).square()
+    valid = mask.to(dtype=per_row.dtype, device=per_row.device)
+    return weight * (per_row * valid).sum() / valid.sum().clamp_min(1.0)
